title: The 1988 Morris Worm: Birth of the First US Cyber‑Team

scenes.text: In 1988 a single code infected 6 000 computers overnight
The worm spread via a vulnerability in the UNIX sendmail program
Estimated damages were between $100 million and $10 billion, prompting a federal response
scenes.query: Morris worm damage estimate 100 million to 10 billion

scenes.text: The attack led directly to the creation of the first US Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT)
scenes.query: Morris worm led to creation of CERT

scenes.text: Follow for daily tech you should actually know.

description: The Morris Worm wasn't just a virus—it sparked the birth of the nation’s first cyber‑defense team. Follow for more real hacking legends!
